name: 22380-mtpwidebatch-qwen35moe35b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, bf16, 71.9 GB of weights. Apache-2.0, ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 3600 s safety cap; 921 requests measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 1024 prompt tokens (stdev 0) and 1024 output tokens (stdev 0), with `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0` and a static seed.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a mid-size mixture-of-experts model, serving 128 concurrent page-length requests across four GPUs.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

tp-size: 4
dtype: bfloat16

# The draft is the checkpoint's own MTP head, so no draft path is set -- the draft worker falls
# back to the target's. NEXTN normalises to EAGLE internally, and topk 1 is the only value the
# overlap speculative worker accepts.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# NOT the default: the field resolves `auto` -> `no_buffer`. It also requires the radix cache to
# stay enabled -- the server refuses to start with `--disable-radix-cache`.
mamba-scheduler-strategy: extra_buffer

# Any speculative algorithm resets `max_running_requests` to 48 when it is unset, which would
# hold the resident batch far below the declared 128 streams.
max-running-requests: 160

context-length: 4096

# Written out rather than left to auto-selection: a host that fails the Hopper probe falls back
# to triton and quietly serves a different attention path.
attention-backend: fa3

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 22380
